text:
[Council File 26-0529]
Department of Animal Services report relative to establishing retail space, or leasing retail space to third parties, to sell pet supplies in each animal shelter facility to generate revenue for animal shelter operations.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Animal Services asks whether to open pet supply retail space in each animal shelter, or lease that space to outside sellers, to raise money for shelter operations.
